recommended_fix: Change correct_answer from 'C' to 'A' (100%). Fix explanation to conclude (35/35)*100 = 100%, removing the fabricated 'Note' that swaps in the wrong ratio.
notes: Same systematic percentage-increase error as id a51fd936 above (both involve the identical 35->70 production-cost figures), suggesting a shared source-generation bug across both questions.
